title: Physical-Space Scarring in Generic Bunimovich Stadia
summary: For the family of Dirichlet stadia $S_t$ whose rectangular part has height $π$ and half-length $πt/2$, $t \in [1,2]$, we show that for Lebesgue almost every $t$ there exist real eigenfunctions $u_j$ and a smooth mean-zero physical observable $Q$ for which $\langle Q u_j,u_j\rangle$ has a non-zero subsequential limit. Consequently, along the same subsequence, the eigenfunction mass fails to equidistribute on a fixed region whose relative boundary in the interior of the stadium is smooth.
